name: naphazoline + pheniramine
uses: Uses temporarily relieves itching and redness caused by pollen, ragweed, grass, animal hair and dander.
otcwarn: Do not use if you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product if solution changes color or becomes cloudy Ask a doctor before use if you have heart disease high blood pressure trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland narrow angle glaucoma Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience eye pain changes in vision redness or irritation of the eye that worsens or lasts more than 72 hours
